name: my-personal-policy
notes: PERSONAL policy -- starts identical to assistant/default_policy.json. Edit the numbers above to reflect your own risk tolerance (e.g. max_position_pct, max_total_exposure_pct, allow_new_positions) rather than editing the project default. Point the CLI at this file with --policy assistant/my_policy.json, or set it in the Streamlit sidebar's 'Policy file' field. Bump 'version' whenever you change a value -- proposals are pinned to the policy version they were generated under and won't re-validate against a different one.
